AI 写小说是一项工程。我们把这个工程拆解，对不同场景和任务进行不同模型的测评。: Writing fiction with AI is an engineering project. We break that problem apart and benchmark models task by task.

每期公开完整数据、评分口径和测试局限，希望我们的测评结果对你的写作有所帮助。: Every issue publishes the full data, the scoring rules and the limits of the test. We hope it helps in your writing.

控制测试输入，机器自动采集，真人双盲参评，科学数据清洗。: Controlled inputs, automated collection, double-blind human review, principled data cleaning.
不同写作场景的测试，均保证有统一的输入，每个模型可独立生成多次结果，互不干扰。: Whatever the writing scenario, every model gets the same input and generates its runs independently, with no cross-contamination.
写作效果无法完全依赖模型评分，真人对正文的评价更具参考价值。真人评分时不知道模型: Writing quality can't be left to model graders — a human reading the prose tells you more. Our reviewers never see which model wrote what.
科学剔除异常值，判别力不足的样本整批排除，再进行数据统计。样本量和数据口径完全透: Outliers are removed on a stated rule, reviewers whose scores show no discriminating power are dropped wholesale, and only then do we count. Sample sizes and definitions are fully public.
